highlights.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 is in the model picker
highlights.line: You can pick Claude Haiku 5.5 for an agent: the newest Haiku, a quick, low-cost Claude model for small jobs done often.

highlights.title: Kosmos says when an agent is stuck
highlights.line: An agent stuck on sign-in or a rate limit for a while says how long and what to do on its card, and shows under Issue.

highlights.title: Kosmos fits a phone screen better
highlights.line: On a phone, a project's name gets two lines, its message box hint fits, and Settings' Community section fits most phone screens.

highlights.title: Your board stays in its window
highlights.line: On a computer running your agents, another site can no longer replace your board. Clicked links to other sites open in your browser.
